crossRefs.note: For all this they still sinned, and didn’t believe in his wondrous works.
Don’t harden your heart, as at Meribah, as in the day of Massah in the wilderness,
They soon forgot his works. They didn’t wait for his counsel,
Also in Horeb you provoked Yahweh to wrath, and Yahweh was angry with you to destroy you.
Yahweh said to me, “Arise, get down quickly from here; for your people whom you have brought out of Egypt have…
For who, when they heard, rebelled? Wasn’t it all those who came out of Egypt led by Moses?

translations.web: Yet they still went on to sin against him, to rebel against the Most High in the desert.
translations.bsb: But they continued to sin against Him, rebelling in the desert against the Most High.
translations.kjv: And they sinned yet more against him by provoking the most High in the wilderness.
translations.asv: Yet went they on still to sin against him, To rebel against the Most High in the desert.
